records.failureSummary: Added test/deploy-contract.test.js: four node --test cases named [AC-24], [AC-25], [AC-26], [AC-29] that parse Dockerfile and README.md with fs.readFileSync plus regexes only (no docker CLI, no shell, no daemon). AC-24 checks Dockerfile exists, every FROM (and the final runtime stage) is a node:22 family image, EXPOSE 3000, and README documents docker build -t taskboard .; AC-25 checks VOLUME /data, ENV DATA_DIR=/data, and a README docker run line with a -v/--volume or --mount target of /data; AC-26 checks a USER instruction exists and its value (including the effective last USER) is not root/0/root:root; AC-29 checks no log redirection to files (>.log/.txt/.out, /var/log/, /data/, while ignoring 2>&1 and comment lines) in Dockerfile or README, no credential literals in ENV/ARG or docker run -e, no test-only password/signing-key literals, no plaintext password assignment or test-looking secret literal in shipped code/config, and no runtime writing its own .log file. Written tests-first: no implementation existed, so all four failed on the first run with 'Dockerfile must exist at the repository root, expected path: Dockerfile' (4 tests, 0 pass, 4 fail, exit code 1). I did not write any product code: Dockerfile and the real README deployment docs are still missing (README.md is still the workspace placeholder), which is why the suite stays red. pnpm typecheck (node src/scripts/typecheck.js) still exits 0 over 10 files, confirming the new test file is syntactically valid. The red state needs a BACKEND/deployment task to add Dockerfile and README build/run commands; no test-file change is required.
